name: makemytrip-autonomous-web-agent
description: An autonomous GenAI-powered agent that operates the MakeMyTrip website — searching Flights, Trains, Buses, Cabs, Hotels, Villas, Attractions, Holiday Packages, and Cruises — using natural language task instructions, without any hardcoded selectors, and without using any paid API (Claude/OpenAI).

scripts.setup: pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m playwright install chromium

note: This project is built entirely in Python. This package.json exists only as a project metadata/manifest file for repository presentation — it is NOT used to install or run the project. Actual dependencies are managed via requirements.txt (pip), not npm.
